say:1:1441111001:1.text: Well, if it isn't the strait-laced Captain Indris and his right-hand man!
say:1:1441111001:1.source_cn: 这不是我的木头卫队长和他的得力助手嘛。

say:2:1441111002:1.text: What's the rush? Come, have a drink and relax for a bit.
say:2:1441111002:1.source_cn: 别这么匆匆忙忙的，来斟杯美酒放松一下。

say:3:1441111003:1.text: Lord Ravion, we kindly request your presence at the emergency meeting later...
say:3:1441111003:1.source_cn: 沙利叶殿下，等会的卫队紧急会议需要您……

say:4:1441111004:1.text: Meeting? Oh, how forgetful of me! Seems like you can't lead the dance at the ball tonight...
say:4:1441111004:1.source_cn: 瞧我这脑子，本来还想让你来今晚的隐面舞宴领舞呢。

say:5:1441111005:1.text: You'll have to attend the meeting for me, Indris.
say:5:1441111005:1.source_cn: 那就辛苦我的卫队长代我出席会议了。

choice_prompt:7:1441111005.text: You'll have to attend the meeting for me, Indris.
choice_prompt:7:1441111005.source_cn: 那就辛苦我的卫队长代我出席会议了。

say:8:1441111006:1.text: As you can see, I have a lot of things on my plate.
say:8:1441111006:1.source_cn: 如你所见，每天要操心的事还不少。

say:9:1441111007:1.text: The arcane card, celestial dice, grand balls, and moonlit soirées—none of these come together easily.
say:9:1441111007:1.source_cn: 奥术牌，四面骰，盛装舞，夜宫乐会……样样都需要人手和玩伴。

say:10:1441111008:1.text: Organizing them is tiring, even though they are meant to bring joy to the people.
say:10:1441111008:1.source_cn: 虽然为的是大家共同欢乐，把事情操办起来还真累人。

say:11:1441111009:1.text: Are you interested in the ball?
say:11:1441111009:1.source_cn: 梅林对今晚的隐面舞宴感兴趣吗？
say:11:1441111009:1.male: Are you interested in the ball?
say:11:1441111009:1.female: Are you interested in the ball?

choice_prompt:12:1441111009.text: Are you interested in the ball?
choice_prompt:12:1441111009.source_cn: 梅林对今晚的隐面舞宴感兴趣吗？
choice_prompt:12:1441111009.male: Are you interested in the ball?
choice_prompt:12:1441111009.female: Are you interested in the ball?

say:13:1441111010:1.text: Here's my plan—I'll light up the hall with jars filled with fireflies and scatter fluorescent butterfly dust, while the guests dance gracefully in the glow...
say:13:1441111010:1.source_cn: 原本想在宝石瓶里装上夜荧虫为舞宴照明，由冷光焰火洒下蝴...

say:14:1441111011:1.text: Veteran officials, distinguished nobles, and prominent figures of Sal'thorin will be present.
say:14:1441111011:1.source_cn: 王国元老，显赫勋贵，名流雅士……届时萨洛克兰大半重要人...

say:15:1441111012:1.text: It's the perfect chance for anyone looking to build connections, talk about current affairs, and dig up secrets.
say:15:1441111012:1.source_cn: 想博取声名，结交权贵，畅谈时局，探听隐秘，都是再好不过...

say:16:1441111013:0.text: It's a shame both you and Indris can't be there.
say:16:1441111013:0.source_cn: 你和因度厄都缺席，可真是一大憾事。

choice_prompt:17:1441111013.text: It's a shame both you and Indris can't be there.
choice_prompt:17:1441111013.source_cn: 你和因度厄都缺席，可真是一大憾事。

say:18:1441111014:0.text: Is that what you think of me? Too boring!

say:19:1441111015:0.text: Actually, I just want to watch the guests with inflated egos pretending to be nice just for a little gain. Don't you think it's fun?
say:19:1441111015:0.source_cn: 看这些自诩尊贵之人为了一点点利益席间欢笑，不是很有趣吗？

choice:17:0:1.text: Is that why you host the ball?
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 这是你想借舞会达成的目的？
choice:17:0:1.male: Is that why you host the ball?
choice:17:0:1.female: Is that why you host the ball?

choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 你想借舞会培养自己的势力？

choice:12:0:1.text: I am, but I can't make it.
choice:12:0:1.male: I am, but I can't make it.
choice:12:0:1.female: I am, but I can't make it.
